task_1.title: Fix groupby_bins ordering for unsorted binning coordinates
task_1.description: The update fixes an xarray binning regression where `DataArray.groupby_bins` could return aggregated results in the wrong bin order when the grouped coordinate values were unsorted. After upgrading, grouped bin outputs should stay aligned with their bin labels and match pandas-style binning semantics across normal aggregation and mapping operations.

synthesized_requirement.problem_statement: Ensure that bin-based grouping returns results in the correct bin order even when the grouped coordinate values are unsorted, so aggregated values remain aligned with their reported bins and match expected histogram-style counts.

expectation.grounded: `DataArray.groupby_bins` should preserve the logical order of bin categories when grouping by coordinates that are sorted, reversed, or arbitrarily ordered. Aggregation methods such as `.sum()`, `.count()`, and `.map(...)` should return values aligned with the emitted bin labels, and custom `labels=` should remain attached to the correct grouped results. Behavior should be consistent whether xarray executes the operation with or without flox acceleration.
expectation.conceptual: Grouping data into bins should produce correctly ordered, correctly labeled results regardless of the original order of the grouping values. Users should see the same bin-to-value alignment they would expect from standard data analysis tools, including when custom labels are supplied.

constraints.grounded: The fix must not change how out-of-range values are excluded from right-binned groups, must not alter the original array dimensions, and must preserve parity between available execution backends. Existing empty-bin and no-data-in-bins error behavior should remain intact.
constraints.conceptual: The change should correct bin ordering without changing unrelated grouping rules, data shape preservation, or existing error cases. It should remain a compatibility fix rather than a new API behavior.

behavior: `DataArray.groupby_bins` now orders grouped bin outputs by bin category order rather than the incidental order returned from unique unsorted grouped values.
Aggregated results stay aligned with their interval bin coordinates when the grouped coordinate is reversed or otherwise unsorted.
Supplying explicit bin labels continues to work, with labels attached to the correctly ordered grouped results.
Applying `.map(...)` over `groupby_bins` follows the same corrected ordering semantics as direct aggregation methods.
Observed behavior is consistent across flox-enabled and flox-disabled execution paths.
acceptance_criteria: When grouping a `DataArray` with unsorted coordinate values into bins and calling `.sum()` or `.count()`, the returned values should correspond to the correct bins in ascending bin order.
When the grouped coordinate values are reversed, `groupby_bins` should produce the same ordered grouped result as when the coordinate values are already sorted.
When custom labels are passed to `groupby_bins(..., labels=...)`, the output should retain those labels in the correct order and attached to the correct aggregated values.
When `groupby_bins(...).map(...)` is used to compute a per-bin reduction, the result should match the corrected aggregation ordering.
When the same binning operation is executed with and without flox acceleration, the observable grouped result should be equivalent.
